lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahas siaanap kar rahe man korai ra(n)g na hoi ||
lines.translation: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kapat kinai na paaio jo beejai khaavai soi ||3||
lines.translation: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa teree aas prabh sabh jee tere too(n) raas ||
lines.translation: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh tudhahu khaalee ko nahee dar guramukhaa no saabaas ||
lines.translation: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praised and acclaimed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਢਿ ਲੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: bikh bhaujal dubade kadh lai jan naanak kee aradaas ||4||1||65||
lines.translation: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up and save them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam milai man tripateeai bin naamai dhrig jeevaas ||
lines.translation: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee guramukh sajan je milai mai dase prabh gunataas ||
lines.translation: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਨਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hau tis vitahu chau kha(n)neeai mai naam kare paragaas ||1||
lines.translation: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere preetamaa hau jeevaa naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai jeevan naa theeai mere satigur naam driRaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted the Naam within me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam amolak ratan hai poore satigur paas ||
lines.translation: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevai lagiaa kadh ratan devai paragaas ||
lines.translation: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestows this enlightenment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਜੋ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n vadabhaagee vadabhaageeaa jo aai mile gur paas ||2||
lines.translation: Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਵਸਿ ਕਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa satigur purakh na bhetio se bhaagaheen vas kaal ||
lines.translation: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, and are subject to death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi phir phir jon bhavaaeeahi vich visataa kar vikaraal ||
lines.translation: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਦੁਆਸਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: onaa paas duaas na bhiteeai jin a(n)tar krodh cha(n)daal ||3||
lines.translation: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled with horrible anger. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh a(n)mrit sar vadabhaagee naavahi aai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunate ones come to bathe in it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: un janam janam kee mail utarai niramal naam driRaai ||
lines.translation: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam is implanted within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak utam pad paaiaa satigur kee liv laai ||4||2||66||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru. ||4||2||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa gun vitharaa gun bolee meree maai ||
lines.translation: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sajan gunakaareeaa mil sajan har gun gaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow virtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: heerai heer mil bedhiaa ra(n)g chaloolai naai ||1||
lines.translation: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere govi(n)daa gun gaavaa tripat man hoi ||
lines.translation: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar piaas har naam kee gur tus milaavai soi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ra(n)gahu vadabhaageeho gur tuthaa kare pasaau ||
lines.translation: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By His Pleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur naam driRaae ra(n)g siu hau satigur kai bal jaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur har naam na labhaee lakh kotee karam kamaau ||2||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people may perform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa satigur naa milai ghar baithiaa nikat nit paas ||
lines.translation: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home of our own inner being, always near and close at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan dukh bharam hai vich paRadaa door paeeaas ||
lines.translation: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਬੂਡਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur bhete ka(n)chan naa theeai manamukh lohu boodaa beRee paas ||3||
lines.translation: Without meeting with the True Guru, no one is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bohith har naav hai kit bidh chaRiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai vich bohith baithaa aai ||
lines.translation: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n vadabhaagee naanakaa jinaa satigur lae milaai ||4||3||67||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with the Lord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67||
